title: Sandy Dunes Beach Cottage | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Complimentary 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Resort-Style Amenities: Access two pools, including an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf.* Beach Access at Dune Allen Beach - Short Drive Away * Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertai
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Complimentary 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Resort-Style Amenities: Access two pools, including an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf.* Beach Access at Dune Allen Beach - Short Drive Away * Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertainment at Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place.* Professional Management: Rest assured with 24/7 service for a seamless experience.*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * **ABSOLUTELY NO SMOKING at this property. There should be no smoking within 100 yards of this home, per neighborhood rules. ***Wristbands need to be worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband. *Welcome to Sandy Dunes Beach CottageNestled in the charming community of Santa Rosa Beach, Sandy Dunes Beach Cottage offers a serene and picturesque living environment that serves as the perfect retreat for those seeking comfort and tranquility. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautiful home provides the privacy and peaceful ambiance you’ve been looking for.Step inside to discover a bright, welcoming space where the kitchen opens up to your very own private oasis. A screened-in porch offers sweeping views of nearly 2 acres of pristine nature, making it the ideal spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening.The home features two luxurious master suites one on the first floor with a king-sized bed, and another on the second floor with a king-sized bed as well. The second floor also includes two additional guest bedrooms: one with a king-sized bed and another with a queen-sized bed and two twin beds, comfortably accommodating up to 8 guests. For families, there’s also a spacious loft area, perfect for the kids to watch movies or simply hang out.In addition to the home’s inviting features, Cypress Dunes offers a variety of amenities designed for relaxation and recreation. Take a stroll along the boardwalk through the Cypress Head wetlands, swim in the stunning infinity pool, or enjoy a more intimate dip in the second smaller pool. Stay active in the fully equipped fitness center, unwind in the hot tub, or challenge friends and family to a match on the tennis courts. The clubhouse offers even more opportunities to relax and socialize.Whether you’re looking to relax, explore, or make lasting memories with loved ones, Sandy Dunes Beach Cottage is the perfect place to start your next chapter of coastal living.Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Two Twin BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
